Hallo,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

move.subject: Re: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series (1)
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

thank you for your offer regarding rfq: pump shaft for the new hx series.
We hold a competing offer at 31.50 EUR per unit (offer:70240-0).
Your rolling quality to 2026Q3 stands at 1863 ppm (sc:70210@2026Q3).
Electric power generation producer prices (PPI-D351) changed -3.7% from 2025-08 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-D351@2025-08, idx:PPI-D351@2026-08).
Since the dossier suggests it would help you: one package offers payment in 14 days instead of 90, at EUR 28.31 per unit; the first one keeps our terms at EUR 28.80.
We are happy to pay faster if that helps your cash flow, in exchange for a better price.
Each of the attached packages works for us; please choose the one that suits you best.
We commit to a binding volume of 4,200 pcs per year over 24 months.
Could you send us a cost breakdown for this part?
We value our cooperation.

Best regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, Purchasing

move.text:
Hallo,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the rival quote data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the quality record data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We did not know that - a fair point. We take the complaints seriously; our 8D report is attached. Our current defect rate for you is about 1200 ppm. 

We need to clarify this internally - we will come back to you on price. Based on the market data you showed and the volume, I can drop the price to €30.50 per unit. Thanks for the clear numbers, the 14 days payment helps our shop out so we will go with that. Faster payment is welcome; we can reflect it in the price. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. 

We don't have fancy cost breakdowns to send, but we are focused on getting the parts running on our machines with good quality. Material accounts for about 34 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. Our current Angebot stands at a price of €30.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, Lieferzeit 28 days.

Gruß
Andreas Dralveck
Owner, Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH
